subject: general
question: Which organisation launched a military communication satellite for Indian Air Force called- GSAT-7A in December 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ISRO**__.

__
 
• **GSAT 7 satellites are advanced satellites developed by the Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) to meet the communication needs of the Defense Services**__.

 __
 
• GSAT-7A is an advanced military communication satellite intended primarily for the Indian Army with a 30% capacity utilization for the Indian Air Force.
 
• The GSAT-7A weighing 2,250 kg (4,960 lb) was successfully launched on 19 December 2018 by the GSLV Mk II F11 rocket from the second launch pad of the Satish Dhawan Space Center.
 
• This three-stage launch vehicle, 51 meters tall, has a lift-off mass of about 421 tonnes and an indigenously developed cryogenic stage.
